tactics:
induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    congr 1
    funext x
    cases x with
    | none => simp [ih acc, ih []]
    | some b => simp [ih (b :: acc), ih [b], Functor.map_map]

induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    apply bind_congr
    intro x
    split <;> simp [ih, Functor.map_map]
